native_accepted_draft_tokens: Sum of native commit_rows-1 per verification round, not raw pre-stop candidate matches.
accepted_draft_tokens: Sum min(accepted_end-1,commit_rows), where accepted_end is the first candidate/target mismatch or block width. May exceed the native counter by one on a stop-clipped round.
committed_progress: Sum commit_rows; equals output_tokens-1 because the initial target-prefill token precedes verification.
native_average_acceptance_length: sum native_accepted_draft_tokens / sum verification_calls; one repeat-consistent trajectory per request.
stop_clipped_matching_acceptance: sum accepted_draft_tokens / sum verification_calls; separate observed trace counter.
request_latency_s: Qualified complete-request timer, including native generation, cache maintenance and wrapper overhead. Loading, activation and warmups are separately measured.
native_generate_s: Native engine generation interval, not a kernel-time breakdown.
cache_maintenance_s: Measured cache operations; retain all repeats.
timing_reduction: 1 - sum candidate per-request three-repeat means / sum reference per-request three-repeat means.
count_reduction: 1 - sum candidate calls / sum reference calls.
canonical: Fresh O58 speculative native greedy target-verifier output, not standalone target-only generation.
